map.两种都有实践：URL 路径（/v1/users）最直观、便于缓存与调试，是最常见: Both are practiced: a URL path (/v1/users) is most intuitive and easy to cache and debug, the most common choice; a header (Accept: application/vnd.api+json;version=1) keeps the URL clean but is harder to test directly in a browser. Once chosen, stay consistent and define a deprecation strategy—announce early, run in parallel for a while, then retire.
